from rest_framework import generics, permissions
from .models import CustomerKYCProfile
from .serializers import DecryptedKYCSerializer

class DecryptedSSNLookupView(generics.RetrieveAPIView):
    """Customer support view returning decrypted social security numbers."""
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = DecryptedKYCSerializer
    lookup_field = "profile_uuid"

    # EncryptedCharField on model decrypts ssn_tax_id automatically
    queryset = CustomerKYCProfile.objects.all()
